checks.rule: The reference acceleration curve reaches the three supplied milestones

input.script: Full throttle from rest for12s on flat dry ground; sample every120Hz tick.

checks.expected: 62mph in2.6±.15s;124mph in5.2±.15s;186mph in10.5±.2s; exact same results at every FPS.

checks.rule: Normal and boost caps are explicit and the original controller remains available

input.script: Flat straight: full throttle30s, then one granted boost for2s; all comparison profiles.

checks.expected: Normal caps120/150/180mph and boost caps180/200/220mph; no overshoot; exact per-profile rate agreement.

checks.rule: Arcade braking matches the requested stopping window without stacking lift braking

input.script: Start200mph; full independent brake until below60mph.

checks.expected: 2–3s and120–170m; brake beats Gas/Boost; no powered drag is subtracted twice.

checks.rule: Raw F1 braking limits and the requested distance conflict is measured honestly

input.script: Reference profile with100% stated brake curve from200mph to60mph.

checks.expected: Record actual raw-curve result; arcade profile uses80% service strength to meet owner stopping target.

checks.rule: Lift-off slowing is smooth, stronger at speed and does not reverse a stopped kart

input.script: Start30/90/180mph; no pedals for10s; observe every physics tick.

checks.expected: Monotonic speed decrease; high speed slows more; lift rises within.24s; no reverse or rest creep; frame rates agree.

checks.rule: Natural coasting is configurable separately from lift assistance

input.script: Disable lift and powered jerk; start40m/s with no pedals for1s.

checks.expected: First-tick deceleration=.3+.0004*40²=.94m/s²; exact FPS agreement; no hidden aerodynamic subtraction.

checks.rule: Pedals and steering retain real analog strength

input.script: Use25%,50%,100% throttle for1s; independent analog braking from40m/s.

checks.expected: Larger inputs produce larger acceleration/braking; no digital threshold in the physics; clamp inputs safely.

checks.rule: Steering builds and recentres within the configured times without rotating at rest

input.script: At rest steer fully for.7s then release for.2s. Separately start10m/s and steer for one tick.

checks.expected: Full normalized wheel input within the configured .5s low-speed rise; zero after .14s release; stationary yaw stays fixed; moving yaw changes gradually.

checks.rule: Left/right motion is mirrored and response changes through forces

input.script: At30m/s drive±.35 steering for3s, then countersteer for1s.

checks.expected: Equal speed; mirrored X/yaw; independent travel direction; no instant yaw match or numeric oscillation.

checks.rule: Known-radius demands use v²/r rather than a per-corner fixed speed

input.script: Circles15/50/100/150/200m at30/65/110/160/180mph. Maintain target speed with proportional throttle; observe final3s of8s.

checks.expected: For feasible commanded wheel angles, measured travel curvature yields sideways force within15% of v²/r; same FPS trace.

checks.rule: Over-demanded turns slide progressively instead of following a forced circle

input.script: At30m/s demand30deg steering with an intentionally uncapped test profile for2s.

checks.expected: Travel curvature remains grip-limited; slip grows over time; body and travel directions separate; same FPS states.

checks.rule: Braking and cornering share the same tire budget

input.script: Start60m/s, brake and steer hard for2s; recompute ellipse independently each tick.

checks.expected: Applied acceleration ellipse≤1+1e-10 using each tick’s independently recomputed input-speed limits; cannot produce both maxima.

checks.rule: Traction assistance is adjustable separately from the tire limits

input.script: At14m/s hold full throttle/steer for2s, assist0 compared with1; disable optional response shaping to isolate the tire-force comparison.

checks.expected: Same tire limits; assistance reduces excess demand/slip; no automatic drift/boost.

checks.rule: Pure steering cannot create kinetic energy

input.script: Disable all coast/lift resistance; start50m/s; alternate steering for20s without Gas.

checks.expected: Every tick speed² never rises beyond1e-8; exact FPS agreement.

checks.rule: Reverse is limited and braking cannot turn into unintended reverse

input.script: Reverse from rest5s, independent brake3s, forward5s, reverse request10s.

checks.expected: Reverse reaches5.6m/s cap; brake stops; forward/reverse cross zero safely; no cap violations.

checks.rule: Boost release, braking and expiry remain controllable

input.script: Boost-only from140mph for.5s, release both pedals.5s, brake1s, then Gas5s. Separately hold Boost10s.

checks.expected: Release slows during active timer; brake overrides; held Boost grants once; expiry returns gradually to180mph.

checks.rule: Surface changes are smooth numeric hooks without world/animation coupling

input.script: Synthetic surface changes atz=30: grip.65, speed.7,resistance2. Straight and steering runs.

checks.expected: Multipliers approach supplied values continuously in~.15s; no abrupt speed cap; no unsupported world imports.

checks.rule: Airborne controls cannot create tire forces or turn the kart in midair

input.script: Starty=100 with30m/s forward and3m/s lateral, unsupported; Gas/Brake/steer/Boost for1s.

checks.expected: Horizontal momentum preserved until landing; no air yaw from tires; shared gravity still acts.

checks.rule: All tuned state is immutable, isolated and resettable

input.script: Mutate nested handling; reset after mixed inputs; run custom and standard karts independently.

checks.expected: Mutation rejected; reset clears all response/slip/boost/contact timers; caller data and other kart unaffected.

checks.rule: Failed surface, input or contact adapters roll back a whole frame atomically

input.script: Throw after first valid tick of a.25s frame; compare state/clock/boost latch with untouched control.

checks.expected: No partial state/clock changes; next valid advance matches a fresh controller exactly.

checks.rule: Jitter, catch-up and144Hz sub-tick boost pulses use one120Hz clock

input.script: Mixed controls12s at30/60/120/144FPS and jitter; queue a2ms boost pulse.

checks.expected: Identical1440 authoritative ticks and all state values; pulse retained exactly once.

checks.rule: A seeded five-minute stress trace stays finite, bounded and deterministic

input.script: Seed0x20261120;2400 input changes, every15ticks;5min per rate.

checks.expected: No nonfinite state or tire limit violation; no speed above220mph; all rates produce exactly the same state.

checks.rule: 220mph contacts cannot tunnel through thin rails from either side

input.script: Start±5m facing.1075m-thick wall; full Gas+granted Boost1s.

checks.expected: Kart remains on its original side with capsule clearance; exact rate agreement.

checks.rule: Tuned pair contacts share one solver without profile contamination

input.script: Two karts approach head-on at220mph; one fast, one balanced;1s and a second case8m apart vertically.

checks.expected: No crossing/persistent overlap; different profiles remain attached; upper deck does not collide.

checks.rule: Driving tests keep all tracks and clean lifecycle with an explicit profile

input.script: For every track, drive1s, reset, select another track; no race/NPC/avatar construction.

checks.expected: One checked kart, stable profile identity, clean clocks; original remains default for existing callers.

checks.rule: Mismatched profiles and malformed surface values fail before state can be corrupted

input.script: Supply tuned state to legacy or a different profile; query null/array/NaN/negative surface data.

checks.expected: Reject all invalid boundaries and preserve controller state/clock.

checks.rule: A stopped kart can steer away from a rail under held Gas

input.script: Start touching a wall at90degrees, hold Gas+Right5s.

checks.expected: Turns away and resumes movement without tunnelling; same rate state.

checks.rule: Moving the same scenario elsewhere or rotating the world does not alter handling

input.script: Mixed pedals/steering8s; compare origin with offset(1000,-700),yaw1.234radians.

checks.expected: World trajectory rotates/translates correctly; speed, slip and steering agree within1e-8, identically across FPS.
